headline: Hana Mbeki and Ostrava Quay
body: Hana Mbeki has agreed to buy 49% of Ostrava Quay from Kenji Falkner. The deal still needs approval from the Quezal Financial Authority. Ostrava Quay Terminals LLC works in port services and is registered through Cay & Partners Registered Agents.

headline: Aiko Kaminski and Kestrel Isle Shipping
body: Kestrel Isle Shipping issued new shares to Aiko Kaminski, which takes a 25% stake. Kestrel Isle Shipping Foundation works in commodities and is registered through Sandbar Trust Company. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Elio Lucero and Ostrava Quay
body: Elio Lucero now holds 40% of Ostrava Quay after subscribing for new shares. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Kenji Falkner and Ostrava Quay Terminals
body: Kenji Falkner now holds 49% of Ostrava Quay Terminals after subscribing for new shares. Founded in 2003, Ostrava Quay Terminals LLC works in port services. Ostrava Quay Terminals LLC works in port services and is registered through Cay & Partners Registered Agents.

headline: Ashgrove and Kestrel Isle Ventures
body: Kestrel Isle Ventures issued new shares to Ashgrove, which takes a 51% stake. The price was not disclosed.

headline: New director at Pellow Rock Partners Group
body: Silas Okafor joins the board of Pellow Rock Partners Group IBC. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2015, Pellow Rock Partners Group IBC works in commodities.

headline: Hana Mbeki and Amberley Sound Investments
body: Amberley Sound Investments issued new shares to Hana Mbeki, which takes a 60% stake. The price was not disclosed. Founded in 2021, Amberley Sound Investments LLC works in tourism.

headline: Greywind Capital and Ferrin Key Maritime
body: Ferrin Key Maritime issued new shares to Greywind Capital, which takes a 60% stake. Ferrin Key Maritime IBC works in commodities and is registered through Cay & Partners Registered Agents. Founded in 1999, Ferrin Key Maritime IBC works in commodities.

headline: Liv Hartigan and Low Cay Freight
body: Liv Hartigan now holds 49% of Low Cay Freight after subscribing for new shares. Founded in 2011, Low Cay Freight Holdings Ltd works in port services.

headline: Marrow Bay Capital LLC and Coral Gate Energy LLC
body: Coral Gate Energy LLC issued new shares to Marrow Bay Capital LLC, which takes a 51% stake. Coral Gate Energy LLC works in tourism and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services. Founded in 2019, Coral Gate Energy LLC works in tourism.

headline: Dmitri Delacroix-Pim and Harrow Point Investments Foundation
body: Harrow Point Investments Foundation issued new shares to Dmitri Delacroix-Pim, which takes a 60% stake. Founded in 2013, Harrow Point Investments Foundation works in commodities. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Dmitri Delacroix-Pim and Harrow Point Energy Foundation
body: Dmitri Delacroix-Pim has agreed to buy 25% of Harrow Point Energy Foundation from Hana Zamora. The deal still needs approval from the Quezal Financial Authority. The price was not disclosed. Founded in 2011, Harrow Point Energy Foundation works in shipping.

headline: Harrow Point Resources and Wexmoor Ventures IBC
body: Wexmoor Ventures IBC issued new shares to Harrow Point Resources, which takes a 35% stake. The price was not disclosed. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Harrow Point Investments and Saltmarsh
body: Saltmarsh issued new shares to Harrow Point Investments, which takes a 51% stake. Founded in 1999, Saltmarsh Trading IBC works in insurance. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Liv Velasco and Marrow Bay Freight
body: Marrow Bay Freight issued new shares to Liv Velasco, which takes a 25% stake. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: New director at Northreach Energy
body: Dmitri Delacroix-Pim joins the board of Northreach Energy IBC. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Lionel Szabo and Saltmarsh Leasing
body: Lionel Szabo now holds 5% of Saltmarsh Leasing after subscribing for new shares. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2007, Saltmarsh Leasing Foundation works in commodities.

headline: Hana Mbeki and Tidewater
body: Hana Mbeki now holds 5% of Tidewater after subscribing for new shares. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Tidewater Energy IBC works in telecoms and is registered through Harbourline Corporate Services.

headline: Stillwater changes its name
body: Stillwater Trading LLC will trade as Saltmarsh Logistics LLC from next month, its board said. Founded in 2000, Stillwater Trading LLC works in shipping.

headline: Aiko Kaminski and Larkspur
body: Larkspur issued new shares to Aiko Kaminski, which takes a 7.5% stake. The price was not disclosed. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions.

headline: Saltmarsh and Ashgrove Terminals
body: In a deal completed this week, Saltmarsh acquired 16 per cent of Ashgrove Terminals. The seller was Kalinda Brandt. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Ferrin Key Capital and Quillon Head Assets
body: Court papers filed this week show that Ferrin Key Capital has owned 100% of Quillon Head Assets since June 2023. Founded in 2020, Quillon Head Assets IBC works in fishing. The price was not disclosed.

headline: New director at Kestrel Isle Partners Foundation
body: Dalia Barros joins the board of Kestrel Isle Partners Foundation. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. The price was not disclosed.

headline: New director at Velden Shoal Freight
body: Hana Zamora joins the board of Velden Shoal Freight Holdings Ltd. Velden Shoal Freight Holdings Ltd works in fuel trading and is registered through Quezal Incorporations.

headline: Coral changes its name
body: Coral Gate Energy LLC will trade as Amberley Sound Partners LLC from next month, its board said. The price was not disclosed. Founded in 2019, Coral Gate Energy LLC works in tourism.

headline: Pellow Rock Assets and Amberley Sound
body: Elio Lucero sold 15.33% of Amberley Sound to Pellow Rock Assets, according to a filing seen by the Gazette. Founded in 2018, Amberley Sound Fuels LLC works in fuel trading.

headline: Mila Ramires and Saltmarsh Fishing Cooperative
body: Saltmarsh Fishing Cooperative issued new shares to Mila Ramires, which takes a 10% stake. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2004, Saltmarsh Fishing Cooperative Foundation works in fishing.

headline: Port Ellery Holdings IBC and Tamsin Bay
body: Court papers filed this week show that Port Ellery Holdings IBC has owned 100% of Tamsin Bay since July 2019. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2014, Tamsin Bay Terminals LLC works in commodities.

headline: Mara Lafayette and Wexmoor Assets Holdings Ltd
body: Mara Lafayette now holds 7.5% of Wexmoor Assets Holdings Ltd after subscribing for new shares. The price was not disclosed. Founded in 2008, Wexmoor Assets Holdings Ltd works in insurance.

headline: Tamsin Bay Capital and Wexmoor Ventures
body: Court papers filed this week show that Tamsin Bay Capital has owned 60% of Wexmoor Ventures since April 2021. The price was not disclosed.

headline: Tamsin changes its name
body: Tamsin Bay Terminals LLC will trade as Calder Reef Terminals LLC from next month, its board said. Neither side replied to the Gazette's questions. Founded in 2014, Tamsin Bay Terminals LLC works in commodities.

headline: Wexmoor and Calder Reef Fuels LLC
body: Silas Okafor sold 15.67% of Calder Reef Fuels LLC to Wexmoor, according to a filing seen by the Gazette. The price was not disclosed.
